summary.key_theme: 市場高度看好 AWS 雲端成長與 AI 晶片業務的獲利潛力，儘管面臨硬體成本上升與 AI 資本支出帶來的現金流壓力。

bullish.title: Amazon Stock is Trending Higher: What's Going On Today? — Amazon.com is rising Monday after Citizens reiterated a Market Outperform rating with a $315 target
bullish.reason: Citizens 給予市場表現優於大盤評級，並設定 315 美元目標價，顯示華爾街對其在 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 合作下的 AI 競爭力具信心。

bullish.title: Amazon's Custom Chip Business Crossed a $25 Billion Run Rate: Time to Load Up on Shares?
bullish.reason: 自研晶片業務營收年化率突破 250 億美元，證明 Amazon 在 AI 基礎設施的垂直整合能力，有助於提升長期利潤率。

bullish.title: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller Just Sold Some Sandisk Stock and Bought These 3 Unstoppable Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks
bullish.reason: 知名投資人 Stanley Druckenmiller 將 Amazon 列為 AI 基礎設施建設的核心受惠股，增強市場對其長期成長的信心。

bullish.title: Amazon to expand drone service to nearly 500 cities after targeting 1 million deliveries this year
bullish.reason: 無人機配送服務擴展至 500 個城市，顯示物流自動化技術取得監管突破，長期有望顯著降低最後一哩路配送成本。

bullish.title: This is One of the Cheapest Magnificent Seven Stocks Right Now
bullish.reason: 分析指出 Amazon 估值在七大科技巨頭中相對偏低，且 AWS 成長速度創 18 季新高，基本面與股價表現存在背離，具備投資價值。

bearish.title: Amazon's Free Cash Flow Went Negative by $7.6 Billion Even as Operating Cash Flow Rose 33%. Here's the Gap AI Capex Is Actually Creating.
bearish.reason: AI 資本支出導致自由現金流轉負 76 億美元，顯示 AI 基礎設施投資對短期現金流造成沉重壓力。

bearish.title: Exclusive: Amazon quietly hiked prices on Echo, Fire TV, Kindle, and eero overnight to offset ‘significant increases’ in memory costs
bearish.reason: 硬體產品調漲價格以抵銷記憶體成本上升，反映供應鏈通膨壓力，可能影響消費性電子產品的市場需求。

bearish.title: Elon Musk: “Starlink Now Has 11k Satellites in Orbit.” Amazon Hasn’t Even Cracked 1,000.
bearish.reason: 在衛星網路領域落後於 SpaceX 的 Starlink，顯示其 Kuiper 計畫在執行進度上仍面臨巨大挑戰。

bearish.reason: 政治人物針對 Amazon 進行抨擊，可能增加未來在勞工權益與反壟斷議題上的監管風險。
